name: Input Buffer
description: Buffers early jump inputs so orbs and landings fire on the first physics step they are possible.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off.

window-steps.name: Buffer window (physics steps)
window-steps.description: How long an early press stays buffered. One step is 1/240 s at the default 240 TPS (12 steps = 50 ms). Scales with TPS if you change it.
